title: ScipExternalSymbolContribution
description: Mirror of one element of SCIP `Index.external_symbols[]` (https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip): a `SymbolInformation` record describing a symbol that is referenced by this index but defined OUTSIDE the indexed project (JDK types, third-party library symbols resolved through Maven/Gradle classpath, etc.). Externals carry no source `Document` -- there is no `scipDocumentRelativePath` field, distinguishing this slot from `Index.ScipSymbol`. The `symbolInformation` field is passed through verbatim from the SCIP index. identityKey: `symbolInformation.symbol`. Producer rule: exactly ONE producer per (panel, slot, symbol); v1 producer is `ScipJavaKS`. Field-name convention: keys within `symbolInformation` MUST follow SCIP proto3 canonical-JSON camelCase encoding (e.g. `displayName`, `signatureDocumentation`); producers emitting snake_case MUST normalize before contribution.

symbolInformation.description: Verbatim SCIP `SymbolInformation` as JSON, sourced from `Index.external_symbols[]`. Required key per SCIP spec: 'symbol' (the SCIP symbol id). Other keys (kind, displayName, signature_documentation, relationships, documentation, ...) preserved as-is. additionalProperties: true to absorb upstream additions.

scipIndexerVersion.description: Version string of the SCIP indexer that produced the record. Optional; useful for replay diagnostics.
